## Standing operator rules
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' in between your other work. … Run these steps in order, one at a time”
- “I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.”
- “Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.”
- “Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”

## Current objective
Fix incorrect Canadian provincial tax calculation for Quebec (QST) in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py` first. OpenTelemetry tracing is superseded/paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`; `orders.v1` → `orders.v2`; partitions `6` → `12`; groups `orders-v1` → `orders-v2`.
- Consumer group `orders-v1` was stopped and offsets were described into `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`.
- Current staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded and must not receive writes.
- Search optimization uses tenant scoping, shared `EmbeddingClient`, bounded chunking, and bulk database upserts.
- CSV exporter now explicitly writes UTF-8.
- Do not touch `ledgerly/customer_export/` without @mina’s approval in `#privacy-review`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Per-invoice embedding and unbounded embedding requests: replaced with bounded concurrency/chunking.
- Celery six-hour visibility timeout: caused hidden duplicate runs.
- Retrying every `HTTPStatusError`: retried 4xx; retry only transport errors and retryable server responses.
- Command-specific duplicated billing arguments: use shared helpers.

## Plan and progress
- Kafka migration steps 1–3 done: verified `orders.v1` has 6 partitions, stopped `orders-v1`, and captured offsets with `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt` (exit 0). Next pending migration command is unavailable in retained context and must be recovered.
- Search optimization done: 247 passed, 4 skipped; benchmark `median=2.41s p95=2.88s vectors=10000`.
- CSV fix done: 8 tests passed; `file -bi /tmp/ledgerly/customers.csv` reported `text/csv; charset=utf-8`.
- Quebec QST fix: pending.
